newsitem.title: USA: Kiwi offers $39 one-way Chicago-Atlanta fares.
newsitem.headline: Kiwi offers $39 one-way Chicago-Atlanta fares.

text.p: Kiwi International Air Lines said Friday it is instituting special May fares, beginning today, under which one way tickets are available between Chicago and Atlanta for $39.
The company said the rate also applies to routes between Atlanta and Orlando or West Palm Beach.
For $71, the company said people can fly one way between Chicago and Orlando or West Palm Beach.
Tickets must be purchased no later than April 30, Kiwi said.
Travel must be completed before May 31, Kiwi said, and blackout dates apply.
